title: The synthetic null bundle never runs the drift latch: observe_bias is called 0 times in 96 cycles
claim: tools/replay/dbg_bundle_gen.py, D15's null control, generates its bundle without ever calling SnapshotRing.observe_bias (0 calls over 96 cycles on --days 2; the 7-day bundle's snapshots store records last_day ''), so D15.M6's latch comparison on the null control reads a clean, never-run latch as agreement: m6_monitor.py --fresh re-derives last_day 2026-01-21 over 7 counted days against a stored ''.
mechanism: The generator drives tests/replay.py:run_fixture, whose FakeHass closes every spawned coroutine but the session restore, so the coordinator's _async_load_snapshots never runs, _snapshots_loaded stays false and _async_watch_learning_drift returns at its first line on every cycle. tools/replay/debug_replay.py already carries the remedy for the timeline replay (enable_store_loads runs the spawned loads), but the generator does not use it, so the null control's drift watch, weekly snapshot and accuracy_drift latch are never exercised and their stored state is the constructor's.

evidence.contention_note: box shared with other finder seats; counts are contention-immune

perturbation.change: --perturb loads: run the generator with tools/replay/debug_replay.py:enable_store_loads in force, so the coordinator's spawned store loads run

metric_definition: Calls of the production SnapshotRing.observe_bias while dbg_bundle_gen.build_bundle generates a bundle of --days days.
phenomenon_property: The synthetic null bundle exercises every monitor D15's steps re-derive against it (the drift watch and its latch included), so a step's agreement on the null control is a measured agreement, not a never-run default.

null_control.value: latch_rederived last_day:2026-01-21 (7 ticks) against latch_stored last_day:'' -> latch_match=0
null_control.note: the M6 re-derivation over the same null bundle shows the stored latch is the never-run default

proposed_fix_scope: tools/replay/dbg_bundle_gen.py: build the bundle with debug_replay.enable_store_loads in force (restored after), and add a gate check that the generated bundle's snapshots store counted at least one day; tools/replay/debug_ingest.py or the D15 M6 harness may then compare the null bundle's latch.
